text:
The plate spans about 360 px, so I used a dinner plate of roughly 26 cm as the ruler. That works out to about 0.072 cm per px.

The food sits on roughly the upper-left to center of the plate. It looks like 3 meat patties (about 6–7 cm each, maybe 60 g each, so about 180 g) plus a side of potatoes and squash or zucchini in sauce (about 150 g).

For energy, I estimated the patties at about 220 kcal per 100 g, which gives about 400 kcal for 180 g. The potato and vegetable side comes to about 120 kcal per 100 g, so about 180 kcal for 150 g. Together that is about 580 kcal, and I rounded to 550 kcal.
